title: HB 79 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, permits the use of a photo identification card issued by this state, the United States, or an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state for purposes of verifying the identity of an eligible voter. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(2) (replaced)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(8) (new)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 1: replaces item (2) of the accepted-ID list in 2-7-112(c) (state or federal ID card with a photograph).
(other) Section 2: adds a new item to the list for a photo ID card from an accredited in-state college or university.
(other) Last section: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 1470332 (2017-01-20): only version saved; slot a only (photo-bearing ID types list). No amendments saved.
(other) note: Companion SB 1121. Failed in House Local Government Subcommittee 2017-04-04 (the action line; no roll call saved for this bill). No amendments saved.
